description: This PHP source file defines the Attributes class within the Api\V8\Param\Options namespace. The class extends BaseOption and provides functionality to add attribute configurations to an OptionsResolver, including validation and normalization logic using Symfony Components. It is part of a module dealing with parameter options for API version 8 in the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: Attributes
classes.description: A class for managing attribute options in API parameters, including validation and normalization mechanisms.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Configures an OptionsResolver instance by defining an 'attributes' option, setting allowed types and values, and adding a normalization callback to validate property existence within a bean.
